entities.summary: Lévon Minassian is a French-Armenian duduk player. He was born in Marseille in the district of Saint-Jerome. He played for the soundtrack of Mayrig. He has collaborated with Charles Aznavour, Helene Segara, Peter Gabriel, Tony Levin, Armand Amar and Sting.
